issues: 画面上方打着调试标题 BULLET TIME，冻结靠一枚 FREEZE 大徽标提示
面板是灰条骨架 + 灰柱，2px 实色边，无轴标签
背景死平，相机环绕时背景不动，读不出是相机在绕
数字标签同时线性淡入，无错峰
changes: 去掉调试标题与徽标，换画面内的时间证词：右上时间码与面板总数计数器都走 effFrame，冻结时一起停住，时码点由红变靛并展开 FROZEN
面板换出版级图表：标题/副标/计数器、刻度与周标签、唯一强调色柱、发丝边 + 两层软阴影
背景点阵随 rotateY 反向视差（5.5px/度）、地面接触影随投影宽度收窄；面板转离主光时整体压暗 9%，一道随角度横扫的镜面反光（裁进圆角）
冻结期整体冷调 + 暗角收拢，进出各 8f 过渡；恢复后数字标签 2f 错峰 ease-out 浮现；补导出 BULLET_TIME_FREEZE_ORBIT_DURATION=150
issuesEn: A debug title 'BULLET TIME' sat on screen and the freeze was signalled by a big FREEZE badge
The panel was grey skeleton bars and grey columns with a 2px solid border and no axis labels
Flat background that didn't move during the orbit, so it didn't read as the camera circling
Value labels all faded in linearly at once with no stagger
changesEn: Removed the debug title and badge. On-screen evidence now carries the freeze: a timecode HUD and a total counter both run on effFrame and stop together; the dot turns from red to indigo and FROZEN slides out
Publication-grade chart: title, subtitle, counter, ticks and week labels, one accent column, hairline and two-layer soft shadow

The background dot grid counter-parallaxes with rotateY (5.5px/deg) and the contact shadow narrows with the projected width; the panel darkens 9% as it turns from the key light, and one angle-driven specular sweep stays clipped to the radius
Cool grade and tightening vignette while frozen, 8f in and out; after resume, labels stagger in 2f apart with ease-out; exported BULLET_TIME_FREEZE_ORBIT_DURATION=150
